name: Coloring advent calendars (cozy coloring countdown)
topicKeys: phrase:coloring advent calendars cozy coloring countdown
summary: Advent calendars made of 24 small coloring books are selling out or going to back-order in fall 2026, riding the cozy bold-and-easy coloring boom and screen-free gifting.
what: Instead of chocolate or beauty samples, these calendars hold 24 mini coloring books or pages, one opened each night from December 1. A major publisher's $29.99 boxed version built from a popular cozy coloring-book line shows out-of-stock or pre-order status at some retailers, and creators publish 'what's inside' reviews and buy-before-it-sells-out roundups. Printable versions already exist on Etsy.

origin.text: Coloring advent printables have existed for years; the 2026 spike follows a big publisher releasing a boxed 24-mini-book coloring calendar (reported release around Sept 1, 2026).

adopters.text: Adult and teen fans of cozy bold-and-easy coloring books, gift buyers looking for screen-free presents, and hobby bloggers and BookTok/TikTok Shop creators.

spread.text: Seen on publisher and retailer pages in the US, Canada and UK, creator roundups, hobby blogs, a TikTok hub and TikTok Shop, plus a competing independent maker with a 2026 edition.

trajectory.text: Demand is pulling ahead of supply for the boxed product in Sept-Oct 2026, and the seasonal peak (November) is still ahead.

productDemand.text: Purchase signals: out-of-stock/pre-order status for the boxed calendar at the publisher (per search summary) and Indigo; shopping press says 2026 advent calendars are already selling out; PwC finds 78% of Gen Z interested in screen-free gifts such as art supplies. Availability is mixed (Amazon UK in stock), so the sell-out is partial.

competition.text: Etsy has many printable coloring advent calendars (single posters and 24-page sets) and independent makers sell physical mini versions. What's missing is a cheap at-home version of the 'tiny book each night' ritual.

gap.text: A printable that recreates the mini-book ritual: 24 one-sheet fold-and-color zines in bold-and-easy cozy style, plus a DIY gift kit, for buyers priced out of or unable to get the ~$30 boxed version.

window.reasoning: Advent starts Dec 1, so demand ends abruptly; digital delivery is instant, so a listing can sell until about Nov 30. Etsy discovery takes weeks, so the listing should be live by about Oct 20.
invalidators: Boxed versions return to full stock everywhere
Etsy search shows dozens of near-identical mini-zine sets by early November
window.seasonality: Annual Oct-Nov selling season; recurs every year

rights.note: Do not use the publisher's or line's name, cover style, characters or product title in the product, tags or ads. 'Bold and easy' and 'cozy' are generic style descriptions; all art must be original.

timing.rationale: Stock pressure in Sept-Oct with the November peak still ahead

buyerIntent.rationale: Partial sell-outs and gift-intent survey data; no unit sales figures

supplyGap.rationale: Printable coloring advent supply exists; only the mini-zine angle is less covered

productFit.rationale: Pure printable; buyers already accept print-at-home coloring

durability.rationale: Recurs every December; coloring trend has lasted multiple years

economics.rationale: Zero marginal cost; bundle raises order value

actionRationale: There is real purchase evidence (partial sell-outs, gift-intent survey), a clear and cheap product angle, and enough time if listed by about Oct 20. Keep it to digital and a small November ad test, with a hard stop on Nov 30.

products.buyer: Adult and teen cozy-coloring fans who missed or won't pay for the boxed calendar
products.theme: 24 one-sheet fold-and-color mini zines, Dec 1-24, bold-and-easy cozy winter scenes
products.whyBuy: Gets the 'tiny book every night' ritual tonight for under $10
products.differentiation: Mini-zine fold format recreates the booklet experience; existing printables are posters or loose pages
products.validationTest: Live by Oct 20; free day-1 booklet plus 30 pins over 3 weeks; $1/day ads Nov 1-20
products.pivotIf: Views but no sales: lower price or add a kids' set
products.rightsNote: No competitor names, titles or imitation of a specific artist's style

products.buyer: Gift-givers making a screen-free advent present for a friend, partner or teen
products.theme: DIY coloring advent gift kit: 24 printable numbered envelopes, 24 cozy pages, tags and instructions
products.whyBuy: A personal, low-cost handmade gift version of the sold-out boxed calendar
products.differentiation: Assemble-and-give format with room for small treats
products.validationTest: Offer as a $12 bundle with the zine set
products.pivotIf: Fold it into the main listing as a bonus

unresolved: Unit sales of the boxed calendar are unknown; out-of-stock may reflect small print runs
